record.label: Walk length and the 1 mHa error budget
record.statement: The authors use a quartet reference to bound the ground energy by −130.1526 Ha and run 47,487 walk steps. Approximate state preparation changes the block-encoded Hamiltonian by at most $4\times10^{-7}$ Ha in operator norm on the 63-electron sector.
record.boundary: The reference energy and the 0.1 Ha window give −130.0526 Ha as an upper bound on the cutoff. Subtracting the sum-of-squares lower bound gives a gap at most 4.834842 Ha. That gap controls the conversion from output-state approximation error to RMS energy error.
